description: This file contains a Spark Structured Streaming application that reads data from a socket, processes it to track session windows based on timestamps, and outputs session summaries. It defines schemas, a processing function with state management, and initiates a streaming query.

classes.name: GroupState
classes.description: A class managing the state of each group in the streaming application, used for session window tracking.

methods.name: func
methods.description: Processes grouped data with state, updating session window info or finalizing on timeout.
